text:
Mira: Dropping a quick thread from today's design review — consolidated notes + a few copy suggestions. Screenshot attached in Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see 'bulk-actions' frame).

Sam: Thanks Mira — main asks were: 1) bulk-select behavior when filters are active, 2) keyboard/focus states for checkboxes in dense rows, 3) microcopy for the performance badge tooltip.

Mira: Exactly. For bulk-select: current mock selects only visible rows. PM wants an affordance for 'select all X results' like search tables. Thoughts?

Leo: From an FE point of view selecting all results is straightforward but we need to surface expected limits (e.g., cap at 10k). Also bulk ops will need a debounce on the action modal so users don't accidentally fire huge jobs.

Anya: Accessibility: if we add a 'Select all results' link, make sure it's announced by screenreaders with the total count. Also the checkboxes need visible focus ring at 1.5x contrast with surrounding row. Current design (thin blue outline) fails contrast.

Oliver: QA flag: when filters are changed after selecting, what's the expected behavior? Should selections persist across filter changes or clear? We should define this so we can write tests.

Sam: My bias is: keep selections tied to the current query. If you apply a new filter, clear selection and show a toast: "Selection cleared — you changed filters" with undo. Less surprising than silently keeping hidden items selected.

Tess: Microcopy suggestion for performance badge tooltip: instead of "High throughput" -> "Optimized for high throughput (lower per-token latency)". Longer but more actionable. Also include a link to the perf glossary.

Mira: Love that. For the badge visual variant, can we add a subtle dash icon for quantized models? Designers: show variant with icon + tooltip explaining quantization tradeoffs.

Leo: Implementation notes: adding the icon is fine. For tooltip copy, prefer shorter text in the UI, with a "Learn more" link to docs. Also we should avoid tooltips relying solely on hover; ensure focusable (aria-describedby) for keyboard users.

Anya: Confirmed — tooltips must be accessible: focusable, aria role=tooltip, and escape should close. Also keyboard nav: when tabbing into the row, checkboxes should be first focus targets. Suggest we add an explicit tabindex order: checkbox -> name -> model version menu.

Mira: Quick mock change: make the row spacing + checkbox hit target a bit larger in dense mode. I know density is important but a 24px hit target is a11y baseline.

Leo: Agree. Dense layout still needs 24px interactive targets. We can compress non-interactive padding but keep interactions the same.

Oliver: For the 'version pin' affordance — right now it's an inline star that toggles pin. Need confirm: does pinning a version create a route change (query param) or persist on the user account? If it's per-user, QA needs backend flag.

Sam: Intended behavior: pin persists per-user and shows as an annotated badge on the model card. It should be exportable to rollouts. Add to product spec.

Mira: Copy proposal for the pin tooltip: "Pin this version for consistent serving in your environment — persists to your account." Shorter alt: "Pin for consistent serving". Any preference?

Tess: Prefer shorter alt. Long tooltips become noise. "Pin for consistent serving" + "Learn more" link.

Anya: Also ensure the pin control is reachable via keyboard and has an aria-pressed state. Screenreaders should announce "Pinned" vs "Not pinned".

Leo: I'll take the FE tasks: checkbox focus, tooltip accessibility, and add the 'select all results' flow. Will add an opt-in on the modal to confirm large selections.

Mira: I'll update Figma to reflect the focus ring, 24px hit targets, and the revised badge/icon.

Sam: I'll update the product spec with behavior on filter-change + toast copy. Draft: "Selection cleared — filters changed. Undo".

Oliver: I'll draft test cases: selection persistence, filter-change clearing, keyboard nav order, tooltip keyboard behavior, pin toggle persistence.

Tess: I'll iterate the tooltip microcopy and provide the 'Learn more' doc link.

deploy-bot: Design spec updated: https://redwood-inference.internal/design/specs/model-catalog-bulk-ux (changeset #421).

Mira: Great — timeline? Leo, can you estimate FE PR size?

Leo: Rough 3-5 days. Two parts: a11y/focus fixes (2d) + bulk-select UX (1-3d depending on backend). I'll open a draft PR once I wire focus states.

Sam: Cool. We should ship a small A/B: show toast on filter-change vs silent clear to measure confusion. I'll add to analytics events: selection_cleared_by_filter, bulk_action_started.

Anya: One more nit: performance badges need alt text for screen readers (e.g., "Performance: optimized for throughput").

Mira: Noted. Thanks everyone. I'll push the Figma changes and link them here when done. :thumbsup:

Leo: TL;DR action items: (1) FE: checkbox focus + 24px hitbox, accessible tooltip, select-all flow (Leo). (2) Design: update mocks + badges (Mira). (3) PM: spec + analytics (Sam). (4) QA: tests (Oliver). (5) Copy: tooltip + pin microcopy (Tess).

Mira: I'll check back on Friday for implementation PRs.

Sam: Thanks all! :party_parrot:
